statements.status_notes: Debian security tracker marks x11-xkb-utils 7.7+9 unfixed for this issue while libxkbcommon is fixed. Upstream xkbcomp commit fa10dbc2ca8bcb45bcecb433520de755e628ca91 guards no-op modmask expressions in compat.c; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2018-15863.

Debian security tracker marks x11-xkb-utils 7.7+9 unfixed for this issue while libxkbcommon is fixed. Upstream xkbcomp commit c342635409cd687da0eda323ef4f165b11565052 fails ExprResolveLhs when atom lookup returns NULL; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2018-15861.
